image_description: An underwater shot of a hammerhead shark swimming in blue water. The shark is viewed from a high angle, showing its dorsal side. The distinctive T-shaped head (cephalofoil) is visible but partially obscured by lighting and water turbidity. Several smaller fish are swimming in the background. The image has a strong blue color cast typical of underwater photography.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The T-shaped head structure is clearly visible, distinguishing it from other sharks.
